description: A script for finding missing internationalization (i18n) keys in component and source files by traversing directories, matching i18n key patterns, and checking their presence across locale JSON files.

methods.name: getLocaleDirs
methods.description: Retrieves locale directories from a specified locales directory, optionally filtering by a specific locale.

methods.name: getValueByPath
methods.description: Accesses nested JSON values using a dot-separated path string.

methods.name: checkKeyInLocales
methods.description: Checks if a specific i18n key exists in all locale JSON files, returning a list of missing locale files.

methods.name: findMissingI18nKeys
methods.description: Recursively traverses specified directories to find i18n keys used in source files and identifies missing translations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that handles argument validation, invokes the search, and outputs results.
